title: Inception
description: A thief who steals corporate secrets through the use of dream-sharing technology is given the inverse task of planting an idea into the mind of a CEO.

title: The Dark Knight
description: When the menace known as The Joker emerges from his mysterious past, he wreaks havoc and chaos on the people of Gotham.

title: The Shawshank Redemption
description: Two imprisoned men bond over a number of years, finding solace and eventual redemption through acts of common decency.

title: The Godfather
description: The aging patriarch of an organized crime dynasty transfers control of his clandestine empire to his reluctant son.

title: The Matrix
description: A computer hacker learns from mysterious rebels about the true nature of his reality and his role in the war against its controllers.

title: The Lion King
description: Lion prince Simba and his father are targeted by his bitter uncle, who wants to ascend the throne himself.

title: Forrest Gump
description: The presidencies of Kennedy and Johnson, the Vietnam War, the civil rights movement, and other historical events unfold from the perspective of an Alabama man with an extraordinary heart.

title: Fight Club
description: An insomniac office worker, looking for a way to change his life, crosses paths with a devil-may-care soapmaker, forming an underground fight club.

title: Pulp Fiction
description: The lives of two mob hitmen, a boxer, a gangster's wife, and a pair of diner bandits intertwine in four tales of violence and redemption.

title: The Avengers
description: Earth's mightiest heroes must come together and learn to fight as a team if they are going to stop the mischievous Loki and his alien army from enslaving humanity.

title: The Departed
description: An undercover cop and a mole in the police attempt to identify each other while infiltrating an Irish gang in Boston.

title: Gladiator
description: A former Roman General sets out to exact vengeance against the corrupt emperor who murdered his family and sent him into slavery.

title: The Dark Knight Rises
description: Eight years after the events of The Dark Knight, Batman is forced to return to Gotham City to face the masked terrorist Bane, who is determined to destroy the city.

title: Interstellar
description: A team of explorers travel through a wormhole in space in an attempt to ensure humanity's survival.

title: The Social Network
description: The story of Facebook's creation, focusing on the legal battles that arose between its founders.

title: The Prestige
description: Two magicians engage in a bitter rivalry, each trying to best the other's illusions while also dealing with the personal costs of their obsession.

title: Avatar
description: A paraplegic marine dispatched to the moon Pandora on a unique mission becomes torn between following his orders and protecting the world he feels is his home.

title: Jurassic Park
description: During a preview tour, a theme park suffers a major power breakdown that allows its cloned dinosaur exhibits to run wild.

title: Star Wars: Episode IV - A New Hope
description: Luke Skywalker and Han Solo rescue Princess Leia from the evil forces of the Empire in this epic space opera.

title: Schindler's List
description: In German-occupied Poland during World War II, businessman Oskar Schindler gradually becomes concerned for his Jewish employees after witnessing their persecution by the Nazis.

title: Spider-Man: No Way Home
description: Spider-Man seeks help from Doctor Strange to make the world forget that he is Spider-Man, but things go awry.

title: Sinners
description: A period horror-action film set in 1932 Mississippi, starring Michael B. Jordan as twin brothers confronting a supernatural evil.

title: A Minecraft Movie
description: A live-action adaptation of the popular video game, bringing the blocky world of Minecraft to life on the big screen.

title: Until Dawn
description: A terrifying tale based on the popular video game, where a group of friends must survive a night of horror in a remote mountain lodge.

title: The Accountant 2
description: The sequel to the 2016 hit, following the high-functioning accountant as he uncovers a new conspiracy.

title: The Life List
description: A Netflix original film about a woman who creates a life list to fulfill her dreams, leading to unexpected adventures.

title: The Legend of Ochi
description: A visually stunning fantasy film set in a mythical world, following a young hero's journey to save their kingdom.

title: Black Bag
description: A gripping thriller about a journalist uncovering a government conspiracy that puts her life in danger.

title: The Fast and the Furious
description: A Los Angeles street racer becomes a suspect in a series of high-speed truck hijackings.

title: 2 Fast 2 Furious
description: Ex-cop Brian O'Conner teams up with his ex-con friend Roman Pearce to transport a shipment of dirty money for shady Miami-based import-export dealer Carter Verone.
